_note: Authored input for scripts/build-card-bible.ts. Everything else in lib/card-bible.json is merged from Cass's data files; these lines are written to the brand voice (~/cardblueprints-ops/plans/brand-voice-2026-09-13.md): second person, present tense, tendencies not predictions, one concrete thing to watch for in the next few weeks, no em dashes.

watchFor.ace-of-hearts: Watch the next conversation where you say the feeling first. Count whether you leave a silence for their answer or fill it yourself.
watchFor.2-of-hearts: Watch for the week you can name their last three moods and not one ask of your own.
watchFor.3-of-hearts: Watch the moment a new connection turns ordinary. Notice whether a flaw shows up in your head that same week.
watchFor.4-of-hearts: Watch for the night someone brings a feeling to the table and you move straight to the fix or the calendar.
watchFor.5-of-hearts: Watch for the plan you make in the day or two after a conversation that asked you to stay put.
watchFor.6-of-hearts: Watch for the favor you say yes to while the no is already forming, and who you tell about it later.
watchFor.7-of-hearts: Watch for the conversation you explain instead of answer. Notice whether your body was in the room at all.
watchFor.8-of-hearts: Watch for the moment you decide how someone is allowed to feel about something you did.
watchFor.9-of-hearts: Watch for the week your calendar holds three people's hard things and none of your own.
watchFor.10-of-hearts: Watch for the group text where you read everyone's temperature before you say what you want.
watchFor.jack-of-hearts: Watch for the story you tell about a person before you have spent one ordinary Tuesday with them.
watchFor.queen-of-hearts: Watch for the help you give that nobody asked for, and what you want back within the week.
watchFor.king-of-hearts: Watch for the dinner or meeting where everyone agrees with you fast. Notice what nobody said.
watchFor.ace-of-clubs: Watch for the idea you defend in the first ten minutes of hearing yourself say it.
watchFor.2-of-clubs: Watch for the conversation where you want the last word more than the better answer.
watchFor.3-of-clubs: Watch for the week you start three things and finish the shallow one.
watchFor.4-of-clubs: Watch for the system you defend after someone shows you a newer number.
watchFor.5-of-clubs: Watch for the argument you keep alive after the decision is already made.
watchFor.6-of-clubs: Watch for the moment you explain something to someone who did not ask.
watchFor.7-of-clubs: Watch for the project you research for a third week instead of shipping the rough version.
watchFor.8-of-clubs: Watch for the meeting where being right ends the conversation instead of moving it.
watchFor.9-of-clubs: Watch for the conversation where you treat someone else's view as a first draft of yours.
watchFor.10-of-clubs: Watch for the detail you keep to yourself so you stay the one who knows.
watchFor.jack-of-clubs: Watch for the pitch you make before you have checked whether the thing can be built.
watchFor.queen-of-clubs: Watch for the moment you decide somebody is not ready for what you know.
watchFor.king-of-clubs: Watch for the room that agrees with you inside a minute, and who stopped arguing this month.
watchFor.ace-of-diamonds: Watch for the purchase or the win you mention twice in the same week.
watchFor.2-of-diamonds: Watch for the money conversation you steer instead of split.
watchFor.3-of-diamonds: Watch for the new income idea you pick up while the current one is still unfinished.
watchFor.4-of-diamonds: Watch for the spend that would clearly pay for itself and still sits in the maybe pile.
watchFor.5-of-diamonds: Watch for the purchase you make on a flat day, and what you tell yourself it was for.
watchFor.6-of-diamonds: Watch for the help you hand over with a quiet condition attached, and when you mention it later.
watchFor.7-of-diamonds: Watch for the month the account is fine and your gut still says it is not.
watchFor.8-of-diamonds: Watch for the moment you use a number to end a conversation with someone you love.
watchFor.9-of-diamonds: Watch for the gift you give while tired, and the resentment that arrives about two weeks later.
watchFor.10-of-diamonds: Watch for the week you count the win and skip the person who did a piece of it.
watchFor.jack-of-diamonds: Watch for the promise you make about something that does not exist yet.
watchFor.queen-of-diamonds: Watch for the moment closeness gets a price: a gift, a loan, a favor with weather attached.
watchFor.king-of-diamonds: Watch for the week somebody's work grows your position and nobody says their name.
watchFor.ace-of-spades: Watch for the true sentence you deliver at the exact moment it will land hardest.
watchFor.2-of-spades: Watch for the decision you leave open long enough that someone else makes it for you.
watchFor.3-of-spades: Watch for the conversation where your hard week becomes the reason the other person is wrong.
watchFor.4-of-spades: Watch for the new thing you say no to before you know what it is.
watchFor.5-of-spades: Watch for the calm stretch you interrupt, and the reason you give for interrupting it.
watchFor.6-of-spades: Watch for the person whose crisis you keep checking on, and how you feel the week it resolves.
watchFor.7-of-spades: Watch for the good news you spend an afternoon looking for the catch in.
watchFor.8-of-spades: Watch for the meeting you win, and how long it takes that team to bring you bad news again.
watchFor.9-of-spades: Watch for the ending you speed up this month, and what was still unfinished inside it.
watchFor.10-of-spades: Watch for the standard you raise right after someone finally meets the old one.
watchFor.jack-of-spades: Watch for the true thing you say on your way out of the room.
watchFor.queen-of-spades: Watch for the fact you hold back in a meeting, and what holding it buys you.
watchFor.king-of-spades: Watch for the week you make three hard calls and tell nobody what any of them cost.

joker.name: The Joker
joker.title: The One Outside the Map
joker.coreIdentity: You are born on December 31, the one birthday the 52 card map does not cover. Your day holds the Joker, the card that sits outside the deck and can stand in for any of them. You read a room quickly and take the role it is missing. People meet several versions of you, and each one is real.
joker.sweetSpot: You use the outside seat on purpose: you take the job nobody is holding, you say the thing the placed people cannot say, and you hand it back when the room can run without you.
joker.shadow: You keep being the exception, so nothing has to settle and every role stays a costume you can take off.
joker.cost: Nobody gets a fixed address for you, so people stop reaching for the person under the roles.
joker.watchFor: Watch for the week you introduce yourself three different ways. Notice which version you would keep if someone made you choose one.
